description: Update a persistent agent's progress and findings. Creates a new vault version automatically - full history preserved. After each update an LLM extracts a single repeatable insight (if any) and appends it to the agent's accumulated learnings - the agent gets smarter every run. Status options: active | blocked | complete.

findings.description: Key findings, data, or outputs from this step

nextStep.description: What should happen next (optional - helps on recall)

progress.description: What was accomplished in this update

name: agent_update
